Comma-separated list of item component type ids
(e.g. tfc:food) that are ignored for bank item identity.
Extends the datapack tag banksystem:volatile_item_components.
WARNING: changing this can merge distinct bank items —
the startup ItemID merge guard evaluates the change
at the next server restart.

Comma-separated list of item component type ids
that are ignored for bank item identity,
but checked on deposit
(blocks laundering item state through the bank).
Extends the datapack tag banksystem:deposit_gated_components.
Evaluated by the startup ItemID merge guard
at the next server restart.

Default off.
When on, every item that is NOT blacklisted can be banked —
the mod's blacklist becomes the sole gate
on what can carry a balance.
The blacklist ALWAYS wins:
bedrock, barrier, command blocks
and all sub-denomination money items remain rejected.
The explicit allow-list stays functional as advisory data —
'Allow Item ID' / 'Remove Item ID' still work
but do not gate anything while this flag is on.
Takes effect immediately; no server restart required.

One-shot confirmation flag
for the startup ItemID merge guard.
Set to true ONLY to approve a pending merge
reported in the server log;
the merge is applied at the next restart
and the flag automatically resets to false.
It can never act as a standing bypass.

One-shot confirmation flag
for the startup ItemID world-repair guard.
Set to true ONLY to approve a pending repair
reported in the server log;
the repair is applied at the next restart
and the flag automatically resets to false.
It can never act as a standing bypass.

Einmaliges Wiederherstellungs-Flag
für gespeicherte Items, deren Mod fehlt.
Nur auf true setzen, um sie zu entfernen:
Die BankSystem-Daten werden gesichert, ihre Guthaben
beim nächsten Start aus allen Bankkonten entfernt,
danach wird das Flag automatisch auf false gesetzt.
